attchmntText: KDDL Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: KDDL Limited board meeting held on 13th November 2026 approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board recommended the appointment of Mr. Suman Jyoti Khaitan, DIN 00023370, as Non-Executive Independent Director, subject to shareholder approval. His term begins 01st January 2027 for five years. Standalone revenue for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 17,467 lakhs, with a profit of 2,176 lakhs. Earnings per share were 17.69. For the half year, revenue was 32,905 lakhs and profit was 4,127 lakhs. The auditor issued a clean review report.
